description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Lists messages visitors sent through contact forms on the user's CloudSites (GearHost Forms), newest first. Use when the user asks whether anyone contacted them through their site or wants to read form submissions. Optionally limit to one site (domain), to messages since a date, and the number returned (default 20, max 50). Read-only; visitor IP addresses are not included. Returns structuredContent { status, total, messages:[{site, received_at, subject, reply_to, fields}] }.

domain.description: Only messages from this site (e.g. mysite.gearhost.io or a custom domain on the site). Omit for all sites.

limit.description: How many messages to return, newest first (1-50, default 20).

since.description: Only messages received on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).

name: list_form_messages

total.description: Messages matching the filters (may be more than returned).

title: List contact form messages
